def save_result(res, name):
    res.save(f'{OUT}/{name}')
    now=np.asarray(res.meta['proprio']['now'])
    print(name, 'done=',res.meta.get('done'), 'reason=',res.meta.get('reason'), 'steps=',res.meta.get('control_steps'), 'chunk=',res.meta.get('control_steps_chunk'), 'plan=',str(res.meta.get('plan'))[:1000])
    print('tcp=',now[8:15], 'grip_open=',now[24], 'q=',now[:7])
    print('status=',r.status())
    return res

def move_linear(target, n=30, name='move'):
    obs=r.get_obs(cameras=['wrist_cam'],video='none')
    pose=np.asarray(obs.meta['proprio']['now'][8:15],float)
    tgt=np.asarray(target,float)
    rows=np.array([pose+(tgt-pose)*t for t in np.linspace(1/n,1,n)])
    rows[:,3:7]/=np.linalg.norm(rows[:,3:7],axis=1,keepdims=True)
    a=np.concatenate([rows,np.zeros((n,1))],axis=1)
    return save_result(r.submit('ee_pose',a,video='frames',video_fps=5,depth=True,note=name),name)

def hold(pose, grip, n=15, name='hold'):
    a=np.tile(list(pose)+[grip],(n,1))
    return save_result(r.submit('ee_pose',a,video='frames',video_fps=5,depth=True,note=name),name)

if __name__=='__main__':
    stage=sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv)>1 else 'approach'
    obs=r.get_obs(cameras=['wrist_cam'],video='none')
